name: fantasy-qiqiguaiguai
title_zh: 把朋友圈碎片变成有梗的编辑感社交图文
tagline_zh: 拍糊的票根、地铁上的怪人、随手截的图——三秒归类成 T1 人像 / T2 拼贴 / T3 压字。
tagline_en: Blurry tickets, weird subway strangers, random screenshots — auto-sorted into T1 portrait / T2 collage / T3.
desc_en: 将朋友圈碎片图片、截图、物件、人物与零散想法，整理成具有幽默、黑色幽默、玩梗和编辑感的社交内容；自动选择 T1 人像主体、T2 杂物拼贴或 T3 全图压字视觉模板，并输出可直接生成的视觉简报与成图提示词。Use when the user wants to turn life fragments, photos, screenshots, objects, portraits, pets, commute scenes, food, tickets, or loose ideas into a funny editorial social post, poster, cover image, visual brief, or image-generation prompt.
why_zh: 不是滤镜堆砌，是先把素材按视觉层级拆成三类模板，再让文案和构图互相咬合——编辑感来自结构，不是贴纸。
why_en: No filter stacking — it first breaks your mess into three visual hierarchies, then locks copy and composition together. The.
limit_zh: 只吃图片类素材（照片/截图/物件图），纯文字想法得先配图才能用；产出到成图提示词为止，不负责实际渲染。
limit_en: Images only (photos/screenshots/objects); text-only ideas need an image first. Output stops at image prompts — no rendering. Humor is tuned for.
